description: Implementing Risk Aversion and Forwards into a Stochastic Capacity Expansion Equilibrium Energy Model - Data is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Dáire Byrne. This is a dataset of parameters utilised in the numerical analysis of the manuscript "Implementing Risk Aversion and Forwards into a Stochastic Capacity Expansion Equilibrium Energy Model", authored by Dáire Byrne and Mel T. Devine. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 9865152 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
